items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: Ron Delaquez or Tony Ponama (PHONETICS) will play a John Kirby record

ctx.x: People listen all the time and nothing would make me think it wasn't done yesterday.

Every once in a while one of the jazz radios here in Boston, Ron Delaquez or Tony Ponama (PHONETICS) will play a John Kirby record, and I'm just amazed all over again how excellent that old group was.
